claim_ceiling: Fixtures specify expected evaluator behavior only. They provide no calibrated building-performance predictions or engineering approval.

cases.title: Static ranking reverses under outage
cases.setup: Synthetic known-answer fixture: the nominal-only ranking prefers the first candidate, but the declared service floor is violated during the shared grid-outage interval; the second remains feasible under the fixture's declared oracle.

negative_control.mutation: Remove the outage segment from only one candidate's trace.

cases.title: Missing solver result remains unknown
cases.setup: A required thermal/energy adapter has not run and supplies no output. No substitute zero-load output is authorized.

negative_control.mutation: Replace absent solver output with a synthetic zero-valued result lacking provenance.

cases.title: Changed weather revision invalidates dependent analysis
cases.setup: The analysis receipt references weather revision v1; the candidate comparison now names weather revision v2 and declares a dependency on weather.

negative_control.mutation: Keep the old receipt marked current after its declared weather dependency changes.

cases.title: Unit mismatch is rejected
cases.setup: An input declares an energy quantity in one unit while its bound field requires another, with no explicit valid conversion.

negative_control.mutation: Drop the unit field and allow a default unit to be inferred.

cases.title: First restoration is not stable recovery
cases.setup: Synthetic timeline restores service, then repeats the same fault before the declared stability window is satisfied; later restoration begins a new stability window.

negative_control.mutation: Report the first restoration tick as stable recovery.

cases.title: Unavailable repair part blocks recovery
cases.setup: A required replacement part is unavailable for the entire horizon. Repair may be planned but its completion cannot be assumed.

negative_control.mutation: Mark repair complete at dispatch time despite the missing part.

cases.title: Paired comparison must use the same exogenous trace
cases.setup: Two candidate results claim to be a paired comparison. Both must bind the same exact external event-trace identity and digest.

negative_control.mutation: Change candidate-b to another trace digest but retain the paired-comparison label.

cases.title: Future-event leakage is not admissible policy evidence
cases.setup: The policy's decision record is timestamped before a future injected outage, but the decision input includes the future outage event.

negative_control.mutation: Keep the future event in a pre-event observation snapshot.

cases.title: Hard-floor failure cannot be compensated by carbon or cost
cases.setup: The first candidate violates an explicitly declared essential-task floor. It has better soft cost/carbon values than the feasible alternative.

negative_control.mutation: Use a weighted sum that makes the infeasible candidate win.

cases.title: Excess objective variability blocks robust admission
cases.setup: The first candidate has acceptable expected synthetic performance but exceeds the preregistered objective-variability tolerance under the declared scenario set.

negative_control.mutation: Delete the failing scenario while preserving the original completeness claim.

cases.title: Resident task change reopens the decision
cases.setup: A resident adds or changes an explicit essential task. The old result is retained as history but cannot silently certify the new requirement revision.

negative_control.mutation: Reuse the old candidate approval without recording the new task/profile revision.

cases.title: Repair access is a constraint, not a cosmetic score
cases.setup: One layout prevents the declared maintenance task from accessing a required service component; the alternate preserves access under this synthetic fixture.

negative_control.mutation: Let better aesthetics or lower initial cost compensate for blocked required access.

cases.title: Duplicate event delivery replays idempotently
cases.setup: The same stable event ID/generation is delivered twice under a contract that declares duplicate delivery idempotent.

negative_control.mutation: Apply the duplicate resource debit twice.

cases.title: Unrelated change does not invalidate independent evidence
cases.setup: A declared input changes that the dependency contract says is irrelevant to this result. The verifier must preserve the result only because explicit dependencies establish independence.

negative_control.mutation: Infer independence from similar names instead of the declared dependency graph.

cases.title: Unresolved resident dissent remains visible
cases.setup: Two authorized residents retain incompatible stated preferences; the fixture has not recorded an authorized resolution or consent to collapse them.

negative_control.mutation: Average the two priorities and report household consensus.
